example.title: Methodist Episcopal Church, Ruter Chapel, Main & Union Streets

brief: Greek Revival brick Methodist chapel: a gable-front rectangle with pilasters and a pedimented front, a square wooden belfry cupola on the ridge, and two front doors. Record gap: no photographs; 7 measured drawing sheets (plans, elevations, section).
